{"id":1618591198,"question_id":3729,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 2 months","timestamp":1745687945,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"295 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1618591198/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Unit Conversion I","memory":"295.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n\n    long long mod = 1000000007;\n    unordered_map<int,vector<pair<int,int>>>adj;\n\n\n    void dfs(vector<int>& ans, int src){\n        // nbr call karenge\n        for(auto nbr : adj[src]){\n            ans[nbr.first] = ((ans[src])%mod * (nbr.second)%mod)%mod;\n            dfs(ans, nbr.first);\n        }\n    }\n\n    vector<int> baseUnitConversions(vector<vector<int>>& conversions) {\n        //adjacency list\n        for(auto entry : conversions)\n        {\n            adj[entry[0]].push_back({entry[1] , entry[2]});\n        }\n        vector<int>ans(conversions.size()+1);\n        ans[0] = 1;\n        dfs(ans, 0);\n\n        return ans;\n\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"unit-conversion-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":576}
